paper_title: Think Silently, Think Fast Dynamic Latent Compression of LLM Reasoning   Chains
caption: Performance of when implemented with base LLMs ranging from 1B to 8B parameters.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between compression factor and accuracy for different language models. The x-axis is labeled “Compression Factor (c)” with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, with tick labels at 10-unit intervals. A brown line, marked “Llama3-1B”, begins at approximately 48% accuracy at a compression factor of 1, and decreases to approximately 28% accuracy at a compression factor of 5. A purple line, marked "Llama3-3B", begins at approximately 64% accuracy at a compression factor of 1, and decreases to approximately 52% accuracy at a compression factor of 5. A darker purple line, marked “Llama3-8B”, begins at approximately 68% accuracy at a compression factor of 1, and decreases to approximately 55% accuracy at a compression factor of 5.
